question: Should status cost display use an exact full-transcript aggregate, require a bounded or persisted aggregate, or defer this display until session cost is maintained incrementally?
rationale: The requested display is useful, but the open implementation changes default status paths in a way that may trade accuracy for responsiveness on large transcripts; that is a product and owner-boundary choice rather than a routine issue cleanup decision.

options.title: Require bounded or persisted status cost
options.body: Keep default `/status` and `openclaw status` responsive by using a bounded read, cached aggregate, or maintained session aggregate before landing the feature.

options.title: Accept exact full-transcript scans
options.body: Land exact transcript-backed cost even if routine status commands may scan large transcript files, with documented expectations around responsiveness.

options.title: Defer cost display
options.body: Keep this issue open until a broader session-cost aggregate storage path exists and avoid adding cost to status for now.

recommendation.title: Require bounded or persisted status cost
recommendation.body: Keep default `/status` and `openclaw status` responsive by using a bounded read, cached aggregate, or maintained session aggregate before landing the feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent status-message history plus broad status ownership signals make steipete the best available routing candidate for the product tradeoff.
